title: Jam sessions in early New York
summary: He sought out jam sessions on arriving in New York and embarrassed himself with singers in odd keys.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Did you do any of that seeking out jam sessions to sort of get your name out there?
Yeah. When I first came to New York. I don’t do it now but when I came to New York, sure.
How was it? Did you ever get embarrassed or have people make things hard for you on purpose?

I embarrassed myself a few times I think. You know the times I embarrassed myself was when I tried to play with singers and tried to play tunes indifferent keys and not really knowing the tunes. And I’ve done that a couple of times early in my career. But no I mean the only thing I can say is sometimes I was really overwhelmed, you know, just being on stage with really great trumpet players and realizing I had a lot of work to do. But that’s good in a way.
